name: Book from Sven's Farm
summary: In Duskwood, Sven's ruined farm holds a dirt-stained journal with no title. Its fragments record an unknown onlooker's glimpse of the attack on Sven Yorgen's family.

sections.title: A Clue in the Dirt
sections.body: A loose mound of dirt among the charred remains of Sven's farm in southern Duskwood hides a weather-damaged journal. Its anonymous writer left frantic, incomplete notes about the tragedy at the homestead. The pages support Sven Yorgen's suspicion that someone watched from the shadows while his family was slain. The account breaks off without explaining who the writer was or what happened next. Sven's clue leads investigators to carry the book to Darkshire, hoping someone there will recognize the handwriting.

sections.title: Unraveling the Shadowy Figure
sections.body: Darkshire's mystics and townsfolk help reveal that the journal's owner was a stranger who fled through the woods in terror. Faded impressions on the pages lead to Jitters, a vagrant hiding in the forest. Jitters's missing entries tell how the Defias Brotherhood meddled with forbidden artifacts and accidentally unleashed ravenous worgen into Duskwood. Finding him brings the fragments together in his completed journal.

faq.q: Where is the Book from Sven's Farm found?
faq.answer: The book is buried in a loose dirt mound at Sven Yorgen's ruined farm in southern Duskwood.

faq.q: Who wrote the book found at Sven's farm?
faq.answer: The book gives no title or author's name. Its writer was a terrified man who fled a horror elsewhere in Duskwood, hid in Sven's barn, witnessed the slaughter of Sven's family, and lost his journal.

faq.q: Why does Sven Yorgen want this book?
faq.answer: Sven saw an unknown figure near his barn after his family was attacked. The book confirms the onlooker was real and gives Sven a tangible lead to learn what happened that night.

faq.q: What happens to the book after you investigate it?
faq.answer: After you show the partial journal to residents of Darkshire and find its owner, Jitters's Completed Journal takes its place and tells the full story.

faq.q: What larger secret is connected to the book's contents?
aliases: what lore is in sven book
faq.answer: The complete journal tells what drove its author into hiding and why Sven's family was attacked. Its story reaches beyond one farm to the darkness over Duskwood.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator, you can use this weathered book to pursue the horrors gripping southern Duskwood and learn how the feral worgen pack gained a foothold.
